chalisa.do1: You are the unseen, the stainless one, ever both without attributes and with them.
Taking incarnation in many ways, you remove the afflictions of the world.
chalisa.do2: Bābā Gaṅgārāma was an incarnation of Viṣṇu.
At the sight of your wonders, cries of victory rang out.
chalisa.cau1: Gaṅgārāma, the god who does good, appeared as an incarnation in a vaiśya family.
chalisa.cau2: The fruit of his former births was boundless; blessed, blessed were his father and mother.
chalisa.cau3: A noble family, the noble company of the good, and a holy name: Rāma and Gaṅgā.
chalisa.cau4: The name of Bābā does the highest good, and brings blessing for hundreds upon hundreds of years.
chalisa.cau5: As his life went by he had no thought for his body; through long austerity he then became an accomplished ascetic.
chalisa.cau6: Whoever fixed his mind on Bābā gained, by his glory, the immortal state.
chalisa.cau7: The town of Jhunjhunu is your abode; you avert the troubles of those who come to you for refuge.
chalisa.cau8: For dharma he forgot every comfort, and seeing the humble and the destitute, he took them to his heart.
chalisa.cau9: In this way he spent forty years; at the end, leaving his body, he was called a god.
chalisa.cau10: In the world of the gods his body became gold; then he sent a message for the good of the people.
chalisa.cau11: He showed a dream to the people of his own family, and told them the deeds that were to come and the means for them.
chalisa.cau12: He gave his own son a vision of himself, and did all the work for the sake of dharma.
chalisa.cau13: When a voice spoke from the sky at night, a lovely form appeared in the east.
chalisa.cau14: Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva, with Gaṇeśa: it was as if all the lords had appeared for the good of the people.
chalisa.cau15: In this way he showed a wonder; then all that māyā vanished from sight.
chalisa.cau16: Hearing the true words, the people reflect and call on Gaṅgārāma in their hearts.
chalisa.cau17: Whoever makes a vow in his heart, Bābā takes away his pain in an instant.
chalisa.cau18: The more he shows his true form, the more the throng of devotees entreats him.
chalisa.cau19: He is lofty in his aims, pure in conduct, a steadfast worshipper of Rāma's name.
chalisa.cau20: Whoever calls on Gaṅgārāma every day, Bābā rescues him from sorrow.
chalisa.cau21: Those who fixed their minds on Bābā gained every happiness in the world.
chalisa.cau22: Those in whose minds the good of others dwells have Bābā dwelling in their bodies.
chalisa.cau23: Do those who hold you in meditation in their minds not find happiness and contentment in their minds?
chalisa.cau24: Whoever watered the tree of dharma with body and mind, the Supreme Brahman drew him into itself.
chalisa.cau25: Whoever sings the name of Gaṅgārāma reaches Vaikuṇṭha and attains the supreme state.
chalisa.cau26: Bābā takes away in every way the pain of whoever remembers him without guile, day and night.
chalisa.cau27: Friend of the humble, benefactor of the humble, take away our sins; we are in your refuge.
chalisa.cau28: You are the five gods, the perfect light; dwell for ever among the saints.
chalisa.cau29: The water of the Gaṅgā saves and carries across; the name Gaṅgārāma is the auspicious sign of both.
chalisa.cau30: You are the ocean of mercy and the ocean of happiness; merciful one, make our wishes fruitful.
chalisa.cau31: The town of Jhunjhunu is greatly fortunate, where the loving Bābā was born.
chalisa.cau32: Gaṅgārāma is the complete Brahman, who dwells in every heart, immortal and imperishable.
chalisa.cau33: The god in the form of Brahman is most guileless; earrings are in his ears, and a priceless crown on his head.
chalisa.cau34: O treasure of everlasting bliss, splendour and happiness, take away the darkness of night and give light.
chalisa.cau35: On Gaṅgā Daśaharā a fair is held in the town of Jhunjhunu, at an auspicious time.
chalisa.cau36: Those who sing your praises gaze on your form, and their hearts are filled with boundless joy.
chalisa.cau37: Taking your name in the early morning brings deliverance from the round of eighty-four lakh births.
chalisa.cau38: The Pañcadeva temple is famous; an unbroken stream of devotees comes to see you.
chalisa.cau39: Victory to the name of Śrī Gaṅgārāma, which carries one across worldly existence, the boat to the supreme abode.
chalisa.cau40: Mahāvīra, holding holy meditation, composed this fine song of Gaṅgārāma.
chalisa.do3: Whoever hears and recites with love the kīrtana, the bhajana and the good name,
Gaṅgārāma fulfils every wish and desire of his heart.
